method: Normal challenge launch, 60Hz stationary human/no-fire. Samples within 60px horizontally and y=300..375 around player band.
limitations: Same-frame bias subtraction is a diagnostic, not a simulated alternate trajectory.
Drawn pose union is an unrotated geometric estimate, not a pixel-overlap proof.
Single seed per stage; primary Challenge 8 tracks censor the lower field; no separate reference for Challenges 9/10.
